info.name: Video Processing API - Complete
info.description: Comprehensive video processing API with all endpoints. Supports video downloads, processing, and job management. All endpoints use multipart/form-data for file uploads.

request.description: Check if the API is running and healthy.
Get the status of a specific job by job_id. Use this to poll for processing completion. Returns job information including status, progress, and output path if completed.

query.description: Optional: Filter by status (pending, processing, completed, failed)
Optional: Maximum number of jobs to return (1-1000). Default: 100

request.description: List all jobs, optionally filtered by status. Returns a list of jobs sorted by creation time (newest first).
Delete a job from the system. Note: This does not delete the output file, only the job record.

formdata.description: REQUIRED: URL of the video to download (YouTube, Instagram, Vimeo, etc.)
Optional: Video quality ('best', 'worst', '720p', '1080p', etc.). Default: 'best'
Optional: Output format ('mp4', 'webm', etc.). Default: 'mp4'
Optional: If 'true', download audio only as MP3. Default: 'false'
Optional: Custom filename (without extension)

request.description: Download a video from a URL using yt-dlp. Supports YouTube (via pytube), Vimeo, and other platforms. Returns a job_id to poll for status.

formdata.description: REQUIRED: URL of the video to extract audio from (YouTube, Instagram, Vimeo, etc.)
Optional: Custom filename (without extension)

request.description: Download audio only from a video URL. Extracts audio as MP3. Returns a job_id to poll for status.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file (any field name accepted: 'video', 'file', 'upload', etc.)
Optional: URL to download video from (YouTube, Instagram, etc.). Either file upload OR video_url required.

request.description: Upload a video (or provide URL) and remove its audio track. Either upload a file OR provide video_url. Returns a job_id immediately.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file (any field name accepted)
Optional: URL to download video from. Either file upload OR video_url required.

request.description: Upload a video (or provide URL) and detect scene cuts. Returns a job_id. When completed, use GET /api/v1/videos/{job_id}/scenes to get scene information.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
Optional: Color grading preset. Default: 'random'. Options: cinematic, warm, cool, vintage, vivid, bw, natural, random

request.description: Apply random color grading to a video. When preset is 'random', brightness, contrast, and saturation are randomly generated.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
Optional: Color grading preset. Options: cinematic, warm, cool, vintage, vivid, bw, natural, random. Default: 'random'
Optional: Brightness adjustment (-1.0 to 1.0). Default: 0.0
Optional: Contrast adjustment (0.0 to 2.0). Default: 1.0
Optional: Saturation adjustment (0.0 to 2.0). Default: 1.0

request.description: Apply specific color grading preset to a video with custom adjustments. If preset is not 'random' and parameters are None, defaults are used.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
Optional: Desired crop aspect ratio in format 'W:H' (e.g., '16:9', '1:1', '4:3', '21:9'). Default: '1:1'
Optional: Background color for padding. Hex format (e.g., '#000000', '#FFFFFF') or named colors (black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray). Default: Random color

request.description: Crop video to specified aspect ratio and output as 9:16 (1080x1920). If cropped aspect ratio is not 9:16, video is scaled to fit and padded with background color.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
Optional: Video codec (e.g., 'libx264', 'libx265'). Default: 'libx264'
Optional: Target bitrate in kbps format (e.g., '5000k')
Optional: Target FPS. Uses original FPS if not specified

request.description: Re-encode video with specified codec, bitrate, and FPS settings.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file (any field name accepted)
Optional: URL to download video from. Either video file upload OR video_url required.
Optional: Upload audio file (mp3, wav, aac, etc.)
Optional: URL to download audio from. Either audio file upload OR audio_url required.

request.description: Merge an audio file with a video file. Both can be uploaded as files or provided as URLs. The longer of the two will be clipped to match the shorter duration.

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
Optional: Upload audio file (required if merge_audio=true)
Optional: Remove audio track (boolean: 'true' or 'false'). Default: false
Optional: Merge audio file with video (boolean: 'true' or 'false'). Requires audio file upload. Default: false
Optional: Apply color grading (boolean: 'true' or 'false'). Default: false
Optional: Color grading preset (if color_grading=true). Options: cinematic, warm, cool, vintage, vivid, bw, natural, random. Default: 'cinematic'
Optional: Brightness adjustment -1.0 to 1.0 (if color_grading=true). Default: 0.0
Optional: Contrast adjustment 0.0 to 2.0 (if color_grading=true). Default: 1.0
Optional: Saturation adjustment 0.0 to 2.0 (if color_grading=true). Default: 1.0
Optional: Crop to aspect ratio and pad to 9:16 (boolean: 'true' or 'false'). Default: false
Optional: Crop aspect ratio in format 'W:H' (if crop_zoom=true). Default: '1:1'
Optional: Background color for padding (if crop_zoom=true). Hex or named color. Default: Random
Optional: Not used (kept for backward compatibility). Output is always 9:16 (1080x1920)
Optional: Re-encode video (boolean: 'true' or 'false'). Default: false
Optional: Video codec (if reencode=true). Default: 'libx264'
Optional: Target bitrate in kbps format, e.g., '5000k' (if reencode=true)
Optional: Target FPS (if reencode=true)

request.description: Apply multiple video processing operations in one request. Operations are applied in sequence: 1) Merge audio (if merge_audio=true), 2) Remove audio (if remove_audio=true, overrides merge_audio), 3) Color grading (if color_grading=true), 4) Crop and zoom (if crop_zoom=true), 5) Re-encode (if reencode=true).

formdata.description: Optional: Upload video file
Optional: URL to download video from
REQUIRED: Set to 'true' to enable color grading
Optional: Color preset. Default: 'cinematic'
REQUIRED: Set to 'true' to enable crop and zoom
Optional: Crop aspect ratio. Default: '1:1'
Optional: Background color. Default: Random

request.description: Example: Apply color grading and crop to square in one request.
Download the processed video file. Only works for completed jobs with video output.
Get scene detection results as JSON. Only works for completed scene detection jobs. Returns scene information including timestamps.
Download scene detection results as a JSON file.

variable.description: Base URL for the API. Change this to your server URL.
Set this after getting a job_id from an upload endpoint response. Used in status checks and downloads.
